recognize_zh: 雙大腿有廣泛紅褐色斑丘疹，周邊血可見核呈多葉花瓣狀、染色質濃縮的「花細胞」（flower cell），皮膚切片真皮有密集淋巴球浸潤，T 細胞標記陽性，綜合符合成人 T 細胞白血病／淋巴瘤（ATLL）。
features: Clinical photo (A): widespread erythematous to violaceous confluent papules and macules over both thighs
Peripheral blood (B): medium-sized lymphoid cell with a convoluted, multilobated flower-like nucleus, condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Skin H&E (C, first panel): dense band-like dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphoid cells beneath an acanthotic epidermis
Skin IHC (C): diffuse staining of the dermal infiltrate with the first two markers and only scattered positive cells with the last marker (labels not legible at this resolution)
Background blood with normal red cells and platelets
describe_en: The clinical photograph shows extensive erythematous papular eruption over the thighs. The peripheral blood smear contains an atypical lymphoid cell with a markedly convoluted, multilobated 'flower' nucleus and condensed chromatin. Skin biopsy demonstrates a dense dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes; immunohistochemical stains (labels not legible in this image) diffusely highlight the infiltrate with two markers while a third marks only scattered cells, compatible with a CD4-predominant T-cell phenotype. Findings are consistent with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma with cutaneous involvement; HTLV-1 serology/proviral integration and CD25 expression should be confirmed.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei rather than polylobated flower nuclei, are HTLV-1 negative and typically CD25 negative or dim.
T-PLL cells have a prominent nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs with TCL1 overexpression, and lack HTLV-1.
Reactive lymphocytes lack multilobated nuclei and skin infiltrates are polymorphous with eosinophils rather than monotonous atypical T cells.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS involving skin
ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS lacks HTLV-1 clonal integration and the characteristic circulating flower cells.

stain: Clinical photo; Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC (T-cell panel)
captions: Clinical photo: widespread erythematous papular rash on thighs
Peripheral blood: flower cell with multilobated nucleus
Skin biopsy H&E and IHC panel: dense dermal atypical T-cell infiltrate
